units.source_text: 源氏大将藏身在北厢人迹稀少的地方，提出访晤的要求。

en.t: General Genji hid in a seldom visited place in the northern wing and asked for an audience.

units.source_text: 一时音乐之声尽皆停息，微闻室内有从容不迫的行动声。

en.t: For a moment all the music fell silent, and faintly from within came the sound of calm, unhurried movement.

units.source_text: 便有几个侍女出来接见，却不见六条妃子亲来会晤。

en.t: Several ladies in waiting then came out to receive him, but Lady Rokujo herself did not appear to meet him.

units.source_text: 源氏大将心中十分不快，便郑重启请道：

en.t: General Genji was deeply displeased, and he made a solemn request, saying:

units.source_text: “此种微行，实非我今日之身份所宜，此次乃破例而来。

en.t: This sort of secret visit is truly not fitting for my present rank, yet this time I have come as an exception.

units.source_text: 倘蒙妃子体谅下怀，勿屏我于局外，俾得罄谈衷曲，则幸甚矣。”

en.t: If Your Ladyship would kindly understand my feelings, not shut me out, and allow me to speak my heart fully, I would be most grateful.

units.source_text: 侍女们便向妃子劝请：“如此对待，旁人看了也觉抱歉！

en.t: The ladies in waiting then urged the lady, saying, If he is treated like this, even others who see it will feel sorry for him.

units.source_text: 教他狼狈地站在那种地方，实在对他不起。”

en.t: To leave him standing so awkwardly in a place like that is truly unfair to him.

units.source_text: 六条妃子想道：“啊呀，教我如何是好？

en.t: Lady Rokujo thought, Oh dear, what am I to do?

units.source_text: 此间人目众多，女儿斋宫知道了，也将怪我老而无形，举动轻率。

en.t: There are many eyes here, and if my daughter the Saigu learns of it, she too will reproach me for behaving unbecomingly and rashly at my age.

units.source_text: 如今再和他会面，是使不得的吧？”

en.t: Surely it would not do to meet him again now, would it?
She truly could not make up her mind.

units.source_text: 然而铁面无情地断然拒绝，又没有这勇气。

en.t: Yet she also lacked the courage to reject him flatly with cold indifference.

units.source_text: 左思右想地懊恼了一会，终于回心转意，便膝行而前。

en.t: After worrying for a while and turning it over in her mind, she finally relented and moved forward on her knees.

units.source_text: 这时候她的姿态异常优美。

en.t: At that moment her bearing was extraordinarily graceful.
